#!/bin/bash
# Count distinct Go packages outside store/ that reference each entity type

REPO="/bench/repo"
ENTITY_TYPES=(
  "User"

  "IdentityProvider"
  "Inbox"
  "InstanceSetting"
  "MemoRelation"
  "MemoShare"

  "UserIdentity"
  "UserSetting"
  "AuthenticationConfigState"

  "RowStatus"
  "InboxStatus"
  "MemoRelationType"
)

for entity in "${ENTITY_TYPES[@]}"; do
  # Find files outside store/ that reference store.Entity or *store.Entity
  files=$(grep -rl "store\.$entity\b\|store\.\*$entity\b" "$REPO" --include="*.go" 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^$REPO/store/")

  packages=$(echo "$files" | while read f; do
    if [ -n "$f" ]; then

  if [ "$count" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "=== $entity: $count packages ==="
    echo "$packages"
    echo
  fi
done
